enableSync.description: True if the CronJob to handle automatic document syncing is enabled, false otherwise.

autoUpdateIndex.description: True if the CronJob should automatically update the index, false otherwise.

syncFrequency.description: How frequently the CronJob should run.

time.description: The 12-hour time to run the CronJob at.

period.description: The period of the day to run the CronJob at (AM or PM).

title: Type containing information about the document syncing options
name: GenAiUiSyncScheduleOptions
